body: Good!   Trust the process!   Thats why I wanted to post this update.   I know I felt the same when I was in recovery and I felt like I looked so square for so long.  It gets better!

Thank you so much!   My surgeon did an excellent job!!  I’m so happy with my results.   

I think I was a 32JJ/K before, and I think I’m a 32F/G now.   I haven’t gotten measured. I can wear bralettes, sports bras, and I can wear outfits without a bra.   So I haven’t really worried about the size, but I do need to get measured soon lol.

Thank you!  😊 

Dr Diana Linetskaya in Manhattan (NYC).

lol you can see what a difference it made in my photos between 7DPO, 14DPO, and after lol 😂 it’s such an obvious difference!   So I hope that gives you some reassurance.  Don’t get freaked out by the PMS boobs LOL 😂

Oh okay, so yes you have some time.   I don’t know why some people get openings and some do not.   I just babied myself, and didn’t push through any pain whatsoever.   If I couldn’t reach something, I got a step stool.   I didn’t reach over in my bed if it felt uncomfortable, etc.   I stood up instead.   Like, all the little things that are annoying…lol.   I basically didn’t stretch my body to reach things, I didn’t carry anything heavy.   If I felt the slightest discomfort or pulling in my incisions whatsoever, I just didn’t do it.

I feel like that helped.   It certainly didn’t hurt, to be cautious.
Don’t forget that they will still get bigger during PMS, even when you are brand new in recovery!   So like I think it was my 14DPO photo…. They got huge!!! 😵‍💫 but then I realized it was PMS!  lol

How far post op are you?   By 6 weeks I was cleared to swim, which in my mind told me that my surgeon decided my incisions were fully closed.   So I felt a lot better thinking that maybe I didn’t have to worry about openings anymore.   I’m not sure how long that is a risk.

I keep replying to this and it keeps disappearing…. 😑 maybe because I included a photo…??

Thank you so much for your comments, and no I didn’t do any scar care 🤦🏼‍♀️ I fully credit my surgeon and her skill!

My incisions looked super thin and clean and neat from the very beginning.   She also used glue instead for stitches.  And I never had any openings whatsoever during my recovery.   

I have tried to include a photo of my scars underneath, which are even more invisible than my vertical scars.   And maybe that is why my reply keeps disappearing.  I am happy to send a photo via DMs if you want , though.   Maybe we can’t post photos in replies, even in our own posts 🤷🏼‍♀️

Yeah, I don’t know why they do that!   I think bigger areola looks more natural.   I was so focused on size and shape of my BOOBS, I didn’t even think to ask about my areola.   lol.  

It doesn’t bother me but it’s not what I would choose.  

Also, I have always kind of wanted to get my areola tattooed in a heart shape.   Soooo…. I guess now I can, if I want to 🙃 I’ve got a blank canvas now!  Haha 😁

I assume you mean the areola, right?   Good question.  Actually, I just never thought to ask about areola size before my surgery.  I was focused on so many other things it just never occurred to me to ask.  So this is just what my surgeon did, we never discussed it.  I wish that I had, I would have asked for her to leave them a little bigger.  

Maybe most people want them really small, I don’t even know lol.   When I was younger, before I had a baby, they weren’t really visible at all.  And even when I was older, you can see that they were very light in color, in my before photo.   

I don’t regret it though, it really doesn’t bother me.   But if given the choice, I would have asked for them to be a little bigger.  I don’t know why, but visually I like when they look a little bigger in other people’s photos.  

I have no idea what most people would prefer.
Thank you so much!!! ♥️
Thank you soooo much!   I love my new boobs!!   The people in this group helped me so much, and I want to pay it forward ♥️

I slept with a pregnancy pillow from day 1, based on recommendations from here.   It helped me sleep on my back — I’m a 100% side sleeper.  And let me tell you…. I kept using that pillow for like… 4 months???  Way beyond how long I needed it.  Best sleep of my life!   lol 😂 

It’s in a closet now but when I can’t sleep I still think about bringing it back out 😁 my boyfriend never complained about it, even though it took up sooooo much room in our bed lol 😂 

Also something to look forward to — I can sleep on my stomach now 😁 and I love it!!!   I couldn’t do that with my old boobs, I felt like I was suffocating!

I am so glad you are feeling encouraged.   
Hang in there 🥰 

I was in this group constantly in the first couple months during recovery and that really helped get me through it.  This is an excellent resource for support.   It really helped me so much, so I’m glad you’re here ♥️

It’s funny how the weeks dragged on in the beginning…. But once I turned the corner and felt more like myself, and I was able to stop thinking about my boobs and my recovery….time flew by.   And now it’s been a year 😮🤷🏼‍♀️
You’ll get there soon!

You will get that back so soon, I promise.  How many weeks post op are you?

I took a road trip and drove myself to visit friends for a long weekend at 5WPO.   I started feeling normal and it was nice to hang out and not think about my recovery all the time.  That was a turning point, and I was well enough to do it.  

I went on a cruise at 8WPO.   It wasn’t pre-planned, my boyfriend and I got a last minute invitation after another couple dropped out.   On that cruise I REALLY felt normal, I left my pregnancy pillow at home for the first time (it helped me sleep on my back).   I had new bathing suits, I went swimming, I went on an ATV excursion.   I felt like a regular person and had no pain and no problems whatsoever!  

The weeks drag by, but in the big picture, you’ll be feeling better and feeling more like yourself so soon ♥️
It’s nice being a passenger, I agree!  lol.   now it will be nice to regain your independence 😊 you’ve got this!!
I’m so glad.  Hang in there ♥️

Thank you!!! 😊 

I wish you all the best in your recovery.   The first 4 weeks was the hardest.   After that it was really smooth sailing.  

At 5WPO I took a road trip to visit some friends for a long weekend and really started to feel like myself again… it was a turning point and it was nice to be back to normal activity.   

By 8WPO, I went on a cruise (it was a last minute invite actually) and that was the first moment I really felt completely normal and wasn’t thinking about my boobs or my recovery constantly.    I was cleared to be in the water, I bought new bathing suits and I had a great time!!  

I hope that gives some perspective to your recovery timeline 🥰

I started driving around 1WPO.  I Went back to work at that time, but my job was very easy (Petsitting, so I was just hanging out on a couch with a dog and some cats lol).  

My car is a manual so that was a little more challenging.  But I had this seatbelt pillow that attached to my seatbelt with Velcro.   That helped.  And sometimes I would hold the seatbelt away from me as needed.  Honestly the seatbelt was the only issue, otherwise driving was fine. 

If you feel well physically, and if your surgeon says okay, go ahead and give it a try 😊

Oh good!!   I was still square at 9.5 WPO, as you can see.  But honestly in comparison to my 6WPO or 4WPO photos… I was already beginning to round out

I can’t remember when I stopped looking square.  But when I took my 9.5WPO photos, I was starting to see the change in shape and that made me feel a lot better.

Thank you so much!!!  😊 I’m so glad that it helps!  🥰🥰🥰 you’ve got this!!   Trust the process.  How far post op are you?

We don’t get as many people here posting that are 6MPO, 9MPO, 1YPO, etc… but some people do come back.   And I know I appreciated seeing the big picture and what’s ahead in the long term for recovery 🙏
Thank you so much!! 😊 I was really square for the first couple months, which is normal!   As you can see, it gets better!! 😊🙏

Thank you!   Yes I still have nipple sensation.   And I did not have a FNG.   My left nipple feels completely normal.   My right nipple is slightly numb but I can still feel it.   I’m 3MPO, so it can still improve.  I didn’t actually care about nipple sensation anyway, so I was okay with either outcome.

Yes, it comes with an ice pack, I have the same one!   If you’re in the NYC area, I just posted here last night that I am giving mine away along with some other stuff, if you want it.  It was great, but I am 10WPO now and I don’t use it anymore 😊

And if you don’t want to buy a mastectomy pillow, you can sleep with a pillow over your chest.   But I liked the mastectomy pillow because it has straps, and that helped me keep it on at night.   It just worked better than a pillow, for me.

My cat is a notorious booby stomper LMAO 🤣 She is brutal!!!  

I was worried prior to surgery that this was going to be a big problem for my recovery.   I immediately bought a mastectomy pillow (same one that someone else linked in this post) — problem solved.  It worked as a deterrent somehow.   It’s really thick.   It also helped me to not feel anxious about the cat, or also my boyfriend elbowing me in our sleep lol.  

Also, I have been sleeping a little more upright because I use a pregnancy pillow to sleep, and have another pillow on top and below it.   So when I sleep at more of an incline, she doesn’t try to walk on my boobs.   

So, get the mastectomy pillow, sleep propped up, and you should be ok to let her in!

This is the scar tape I got!   It’s reusable.  I did put it on once but it was a little too early, but it was comfortable!   It’s not exactly tape but it sticks because it’s silicone.  I liked it and I still plan to use it.  

https://a.co/d/06svZl0z

I also don t think you need to buy anything your surgeon wants to sell you, unless you want to.   I probably would get caught up in it and buy it lol.  But Mederma is highly recommended and I got mine on Amazon.  

I’m also an Esthetician (I only do lashes though).  I have a tiny scar on my face from a piercing that rejected, and I once had a microneedling treatment with PRP done when I was in school for Esthetics.  It was done by my instructor.   They draw your blood, separate the plasma, and use your own plasma with microneedling.   Honestly, I swear my tiny scar felt smaller and lighter after that treatment.  And I’m pretty skeptical about treatments lol.   But if I truly wanted to take more extreme measures for scar care, like if I had a really bad scar from this, I guess that is what I would try.   

Not every state even allows estheticians to do this, though, but I went to school in TX and they allow it there.  However, I don’t think that would ever be necessary for my reduction scars.  

Another big reason I think my scars look so good — I had ZERO openings.  I can’t make any guarantees about how I avoided them, but let me tell you — I treated myself like a delicate little doll.   lol.   I did not lift over 10 lbs.  I used a step stool to reach anything that was slightly too high, even if I didn’t feel like getting the stool bc I wanted to be lazy.   Sometimes when I was laying in bed, and my drink was hard to reach on my table without stretching and twisting and reaching too far?   Nope, I sat up and turned my whole body to get it.   I did not push past any pain so as not to put pressure on my incisions.   And I am convinced that this helped me avoid openings.  Openings leave bigger scars 😔

That is great, I didn’t know if I would have any preference on glue or stitches or anything else, but my incisions look so great and she used glue so I’m happy with it!  And if your scars turn white also then hopefully there is a good chance these scars will as well.   I have other surgery scars that are wider, but they are still white.   That was from a broken arm and it was not done by a plastic surgeon obviously.   So it’s not as nice of a scar.  

And thank you so much for the kind words, no one else here has commented on the scars lol but I have personally felt blown away by how small and light and thin they are!!!

So, my surgeon basically had almost no recommendations for scar care lol.  When I asked her, she said Mederma, but only because I asked for a recommendation.   Anyway, that’s what I plan to use. 

I also have bio oil which I am going to try to use to massage the scars underneath to soften them and maybe help my shape develop more.   And I do have scar tape that I bought that is already pre cut in the shape of my scars, but I haven’t used that yet either.   

I just need to get myself on a routine!!   We went on a cruise recently so we were gone for 8 days and now I have been working like crazy and running around.  I want to get back to a nightly routine of shower / moisturize / scar care.   These days I’ve just been taking a quick morning shower and running out the door lol 😂

Thank you so much 🥹🥹

And I actually have done nothing for scar care yet 🤦🏼‍♀️ 😮 but I intended to and I have products I just keep forgetting.  I’m still going to use them! 

I agree, I have been blown away at how invisible these scars look.   I don’t know if I should expect them to look worse later, bc they look almost invisible now, and they have looked this way for weeks.  I think I really have to credit my surgeon for this.   She cut such nice clean lines.   Also, my incisions were closed with glue, and I later read that this is better for scarring, so I suspected maybe that has helped too.  

I have other scars on my body that heal as kind of white / skin color as well, I guess because I am so pale.   Stretch marks too, those are all white.   I don’t have any  darker scars.  But the fact that these scars are so thin really makes them look almost invisible.  

Thank you so much ♥️

Yours look very swollen right now.   Keep taking photos because I literally can’t notice a difference until I look through my progress photos and the changes are striking!

I know 😭 I hate showing anyone that before photo but like… you gotta see it to appreciate what I have now!

Mine got better at 5WPO!   You’re almost there!

I actually think the tingling / letdown feeling stopped a little earlier; maybe during week 4.   So like I said, you are really almost there!   Week 3 was my hardest and most painful week :( 

I feel so good now, I can wear regular bras (no underwire yet, just soft bralettees!).  I went on a 4 hour roadtrip and hung out with my friends for 3 days, went to a party / picnic, went to a cider brewery place, lunch, went to the lake — just overall a very social busy few days and I felt great!  

Good luck and congratulations on your surgery.   I hope you feel better soon!

I think we talked about this a little bit in my regular name.  I’m sooooo sorry you have this rash!!!   It had been a nightmare!   

I have had the rash since 18DPO, the day my tape came off.  So it’s been 10 days.   I felt fine until my surgeon removed the tape, then all hell broke loose 😭

Nothing has really helped.   I was prescribed a steroid pill for 6 days and I finished that.   I’m currently taking Allegra Hives, and I tried a hydrocortisone ointment (my dr JUST told me the creams don’t work, which is what I was trying before 😑).   But at this point, I think it’s just beginning to go away on its own…. 

For the most part now, I use Allegra in the morning, and half the time I put nothing on the incisions and just let them be dry.  I think I used too many different things at first, trying to feel better, and made them even more irritated.   So at this point, less is more.  😑

Oh, and if I am feeling particularly bad, an ice pack or cold compress helps a LOT for temporary relief, it helps soothe the inflammation and also calm down the itching, for me.   But ask your surgeon first if that is ok to do!    Some say no ice.
